hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880423 (31 Modern Electric sites: 18 list 50-amp, 13 list 30-amp; no site lists water or sewer) + DCNR stay page ('Half of the campsites have electric hookups'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: 'A 70-site tent and trailer campground ... along PA 154, one mile east of the park office.' The booking site lists 59 RV-capable sites (31 Modern Electric, 28 Modern Non-Electric) besides 9 tent-only sites, rustic cabins and group tenting. Listed max vehicle lengths run 15-80 ft, most electric sites 30-61 ft; every site is back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/worlds-end-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880423 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/worlds-end-state-park/stay ('Water and shower houses are within a short distance of all sites. A sanitary dumping station is available') + ReserveAmerica amenities ('Flush Toilets Are Available In The Campground', 'Sanitation Dumping Station Is Available In The Campground'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). Pets only at designated sites.

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/worlds-end-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880423 (Booking Window for Modern Electric / Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance') + DCNR stay page ('Pets are permitted at designated sites'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window. Added 50-amp electric (no water/sewer), 59 RV sites to 80 ft (all back-in), showers/flush toilets/water/dump. Season (closed in winter) already manual; fees left at the statewide table. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs.
